title: Lentil, Cauliflower and Buckwheat Patties
subtitle: with carrot tahini sauce
description: Hearty patties of black lentils, buckwheat and cauliflower, served with a tahini sauce thinned with fresh carrot juice and turmeric.

steps.text: Parboil the buckwheat for 7 minutes in boiling water, just until it is tender to the bite. Drain the soaked lentils and dry the lentils and buckwheat well.
Grate the onions and squeeze out their liquid.
Blanch the carrot: cook for 4 minutes in boiling water and transfer to iced water. Grate the blanched carrot.
Put the lentils, buckwheat and cauliflower florets in a food processor. Add the onion, carrot, coriander, chilli and spices and pulse until a uniform, workable mixture forms.
Form patties of equal size. Heat a lightly oiled frying pan over medium heat and cook the patties for about 3 minutes on each side.
Mix the tahini with the cold carrot juice and season with the turmeric.
Place the patties on a serving plate and serve with the tahini.
